exercises.title: Plan the deployment waves
exercises.task: Write Plan: group services into waves so every service comes after all its dependencies, each service in the earliest wave possible. Services of one wave can be deployed in parallel. Report a cycle instead of a wrong plan. The spec is in the file.
hints: Count, for each service, how many of its dependencies are not deployed yet (its in-degree). Wave 0 is every service at 0.
Build the reverse graph (1.4.1) once: when a wave is deployed, decrease the count of every service that depends on it; those that reach 0 form the next wave. This is Kahn's algorithm.
When no service is at 0 but some are left, they are stuck behind a cycle: return the error with all of them, sorted.
